design.name: 冰河豚
design.brief: A floating frozen puffer fish (河豚), the kamikaze: a round grumpy pufferfish drifting in the air like a balloon, its skin covered with short thick ice spines, big angry eyes, a small pouting beak mouth, tiny fins fluttering; when it charges it inflates to twice its size and its spines glow aqua-cyan from the roots (weak spot: the whole body) before bursting into a ring of ice spines. Comic and explosive.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, scales and fins as big simple carved shapes. Spines are a few dozen thick simple cones, not hundreds of thin needles.
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral bind pose for rigging (normal, NOT inflated):
design.turnaround_pose: floating level, body round but relaxed (normal size, not puffed up), the ice spines lying back against the body as short thick cones, eyes open, mouth closed, fins spread; spine roots only faintly cyan (no glow halo)
design.turnaround_digits: all fins and the tail fully inside the frame.
